name: mnemopath_hunter_ai
label: Echo of Regret's Pursuit
godotFeature: NavigationServer3D, Area3D, GDScript (for path logging & prediction)
poeticVision: You'll feel a chilling sense of betrayal by your own instincts. Imagine fleeing through a collapsing memory-scape, only for the Silence's hunters to materialize not from ahead, but from the very path you *just* took. They aren't following your current location; they're predicting your next move based on the *mnemopaths* — the subtle, habitual lines of movement you carve through memory. Your muscle memory becomes a liability, your most efficient routes, a trap. Every familiar jump, every corner turned from instinct, is weaponized. It forces you to constantly second-guess yourself, to break established patterns, creating a profound paranoia that your own past actions are sealing your doom.
usage: Attach this script to a CharacterBody3D node that represents the Silence hunter. In the Godot editor, set the 'Player Node Path' export variable to the NodePath of your player character (Lyra), which should also be a CharacterBody3D. Ensure your scene contains a NavigationRegion3D node with its navigation mesh baked, as the hunter uses NavigationAgent3D for movement. The hunter will track Lyra's past movements (mnemopaths) and predict her future path. If a predicted future path intersects with a past mnemopath, the hunter will set that intersection point as its target, simulating an ambush by appearing on a path Lyra previously took or was likely to take again.

parameters.name: player_node_path
parameters.description: The NodePath to the player character (Lyra), which must be a CharacterBody3D.

parameters.name: mnemopath_history_length
parameters.description: The number of past player positions to store in the mnemopath history. A higher value means the hunter remembers Lyra's path further back in time (e.g., 60 frames = 1 second at 60 physics frames/sec).

parameters.name: prediction_time_ahead
parameters.description: How many seconds into the future the hunter attempts to predict Lyra's movement based on her current velocity.

parameters.name: ambush_detection_radius
parameters.description: The radius around a historical mnemopath point within which Lyra's predicted future position must fall to trigger an ambush.

parameters.name: hunter_speed
parameters.description: The movement speed of the Silence hunter when pursuing an ambush target.

parameters.name: ambush_cooldown
parameters.description: The cooldown period in seconds after an ambush is triggered before another ambush can be initiated, preventing rapid, repetitive ambushes at the same location.

verdict: In the labyrinth of forgotten paths, your own shadow becomes the hunter, a chilling echo of instincts betrayed.
impact: This mechanic will fundamentally alter player movement and decision-making. Players will be forced to constantly analyze their own habits, leading to a profound sense of paranoia and self-betrayal. It transforms efficient movement into a potential liability, making every familiar path a potential trap. This creates a unique psychological tension, where the player's own ingrained 'muscle memory' becomes an enemy, deepening the theme of identity loss and the constant, urgent threat of the Silence.
